_comment: Words and phrases that mean someone may be in immediate danger (English, Hindi, romanised Hindi, Nepali). Saathi checks every message against this list in the browser first (so it works offline) and the server uses it for the 'emergency' intent. Matched case-insensitively as one regular expression. A false alarm only opens the emergency screen, which has a Back to chat button; missing a real emergency is worse. No lookbehind (older phones).
